verdict.rationale: ROS 2 documents official client libraries in multiple languages, explicitly C++ and Python, with code generators that produce typed message interfaces shared across languages and an idiomatic Python API. The docs also show the surface is not uniform across languages: intra-process communication, composition, managed lifecycles and content-filtering subscriptions are 'currently only in C++'. Missing for 10: any evidence of TypeScript or Go SDKs, full feature parity across languages (Python lacks several core features), independent corroboration of SDK quality.
